notes.title: We update the demo, with a surprise
notes.content:
🎮 The #VirtualLoveSecrets demo has just been updated on Steam and brings with it a special gift. Find the 4 free keys that are hidden in the demo! Do you have what it takes to discover them?
Only the fastest and smartest will be able to get it in time, you can exchange them or give them away, you decide, good luck to everyone, since I hide them very well.
